{"subject":"Priya as CTO at Quillstack","body":"Hi,

I saw that in January Priya (@priya-k) was listed as CTO and maintainer on Quillstack's GitHub. That looks like a meaningful step for the team. Congratulations.

I'd enjoy hearing how things are going and what you're focused on next. Would you be open to a 20-minute call in the coming weeks? Happy to work around your schedule.

Marcus"}
